seo_title: HCPS Training & Certification Academy | Dealer Product Training & Certification
seo_description: Self-paced product and sales training for home medical equipment dealers. Enroll your team, track progress, and earn the HCPS Lift Chair Sales & Product Knowledge Certification — included for eligible HCPS network dealers.

hero.headline: Build Product Knowledge. Strengthen Your Team. Certify With Confidence.
hero.lead: Self-paced, dealer-focused training on the product lines HCPS represents — built so your staff can explain, fit and sell with confidence, and earn an HCPS certification that shows it.
hero.image_alt: HCPS Training & Certification Academy — a Golden Technologies lift chair beside a laptop showing the Academy course, with the headline "Build Product Knowledge. Strengthen Your Team. Certify With Confidence." and Learn, Train, Sell and Earn HCPS Certification icons
hero.side_image_alt: A man relaxing in a navy Golden Technologies power lift recliner in a bright living room

why.title: Training that turns floor staff into confident product specialists
why.intro: Every course is written for the showroom floor: what the customer is asking, what the product actually does, and how to recommend the right model the first time.

cards.title: Product education
cards.description: Accurate, manufacturer-sourced product knowledge — models, positioning systems, sizing, fabrics and options — in short, visual lessons.

cards.title: Sales confidence
cards.description: Real customer scenarios and a proven consultation method, so new and experienced staff ask better questions and close with confidence.

cards.title: Self-paced learning
cards.description: Lessons work on a phone, tablet or desktop and save progress automatically, so staff can learn between appointments.

cards.title: Certification
cards.description: A timed final exam and an HCPS-issued certificate your team can verify online — proof of knowledge for your customers and managers.

cards.title: Employee development
cards.description: A clear path for onboarding new hires and keeping experienced staff current as product lines change.

courses.title: Start with the HCPS Lift Chair Sales & Product Knowledge Certification
courses.intro: Our first certification is live today. More courses for the lines HCPS represents are in development.

items.title: HCPS Lift Chair Sales & Product Knowledge Certification

items.title: Showroom & Consultation Skills

dashboard.title: See your whole team's training in one place
dashboard.intro: Your dealership's Training Manager invites staff, assigns courses and follows progress — without ever seeing another dealership's people.

points.title: Enroll employees
points.description: Invite staff by email — no passwords to manage. Partner 360 users can open Training straight from the portal.

points.title: Assign training
points.description: Enroll each person in the courses that fit their role, with an optional due date.

points.title: Track progress
points.description: Lessons completed, exam passed or not and the number of attempts — at a glance, for every location you manage.

points.title: Certification visibility
points.description: Certificate numbers, issue and expiry dates, and an early warning when a certificate is about to expire.

dashboard.preview_note: Illustration — sample names, not real people.

how.title: From invitation to certificate in five steps

steps.title: Access the Academy
steps.description: Sign in with a one-time email code, or open Training from HCPS Partner 360.

steps.title: Enroll employees
steps.description: Your Training Manager — or HCPS — invites staff and enrolls them in a course.

steps.title: Complete training
steps.description: Short, visual lessons with practice checks, on any device. Progress saves automatically.

steps.title: Pass the assessment
steps.description: A timed final exam drawn from every module. 80% earns the certification.

steps.title: Earn the certificate
steps.description: An HCPS-issued certificate with a number anyone can verify online, valid for 12 months.

pricing.title: Included for HCPS dealers. Open to more dealers soon.
pricing.intro: Training is part of the support HCPS gives the dealers in our network. Paid access for other dealerships is planned.

tiers.title: Eligible HCPS network dealers
tiers.description: Active dealers in the HCPS network can enroll their staff in available Academy courses. Some future premium programs may have their own eligibility rules.

tiers.title: Dealers outside the HCPS network
tiers.description: Paid course access is coming soon. Proposed price for the HCPS Lift Chair Sales & Product Knowledge Certification: $19.99. Each course will carry its own price.

pricing.footnote: Paid course access coming soon — no payment is taken today. Proposed prices are subject to change and to manufacturer permissions for commercial training.

certificate_note: HCPS certificates are issued by Home Care Provider Services. The HCPS Lift Chair Sales & Product Knowledge Certification is independent dealer sales training developed and administered by HCPS; it is not issued, sponsored or endorsed by Golden Technologies.
